notes: Replies stream into the chat: a live line shows what the model is doing (Thinking…, writing the answer or a tool call), a seconds counter, and the answer text as it arrives. edit_file takes several edits at once and matches text more tolerantly. Tool calls and results stay in the chat history within a budget, and long chats are compacted automatically. Failed calls are retried with growing waits, repeated identical tool calls are stopped, and a Continue button appears at the step limit. Prompt caching now also works on native Anthropic and Bedrock.
